# Reacting Ltd

> Reacting Ltd is a UK software company building operational software for dental practices. Dental Assist is its first product: a named software workspace for stock, expiry, suppliers, supplier quotes (RFQ), purchasing, deliveries and spend — developed and refined inside a real working dental practice.

Dental Assist is not a practice-management system (PMS) and does not replace clinical records, appointment booking or patient management. It runs alongside the PMS as the operational layer for materials, purchasing and supplier relationships.

Dental Assist is built for dental practice owners and principals, practice managers, nurses and stock leads, and dental practices generally — not for hospitals, warehouses or general retail inventory. Pricing is a single practice plan (currently £59/month) with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required, unlimited products and unlimited team members.

## Company and product

- Company: Reacting Ltd (Companies House company number 16587479)
- Product: Dental Assist
- Positioning: operational software for dental practices, working alongside clinical and practice-management software — not a replacement PMS

## What Dental Assist helps practices see and organise

Practices often run day-to-day operations from fragmented information — spreadsheets, messages and memory. Dental Assist brings that work into one workspace:

- Stock visibility and low-stock risk
- Expiry tracking and earlier awareness of potential write-offs
- Suppliers
- Supplier quotes / RFQ price comparison
- Purchasing and orders
- Deliveries and receiving
- Spend visibility
- Savings and operational reporting

Dental Assist does not guarantee cost reduction or savings.
